spine: Tyson, Critical Theory Today (4th ed., 2023) for each lens + the Norton Anthology of Theory and Criticism (2nd ed.) for the theorists + one novel per lens (all in collection)
rules: A reading major: most days are a reading day (one ~25-minute slice + 2-3 guide questions, answered optionally); a seminar day (real lesson page) every 4 reading days; each course ends with a short lens essay.
Readings, day counts and books per course come from build_plan.py (re-run after edits); READING-PLAN.md is generated.
